'''Moro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], he informed fellow officer [[Danod]] about the death of [[Ben Kahob]] at the hands of the [[Coronas]] gang.
